segments: Sovabazar Rajbari's idol goes by boat

caption.en:
Durga Puja immersion in Kolkata: where the idols go to the river 🙏

Every year bisarjan starts on Bijoya Dashami and goes on for days at the ghats along the Hooghly. At Baghbazar Ghat, Sovabazar Rajbari's idol goes out on the river by boat.

These clips are from past years.

Which ghat did your para go to this year? Tell us 👇
